hook.say: Turkey is a land of mountains and sleeping volcanoes. Five questions. Watch out for the tricky last one!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which mountain range runs parallel to Türkiye's Mediterranean coast?
questions.say: Which mountain range runs parallel to Turkey's Mediterranean coast?
questions.fact: The Taurus separate the Mediterranean coast from the central plateau.
questions.sayAnswer: The Taurus Mountains! They separate the Mediterranean coast from the central plateau.

questions.q: Uludağ, a famous ski mountain, rises above which city?
questions.say: Oo-loo-dah, a famous ski mountain, rises above which city?
questions.fact: At 2,543 m, Uludağ is the highest mountain of the Marmara region.
questions.sayAnswer: Bursa! At 2543 meters, it is the highest mountain of the Marmara region.

questions.q: Which snow-capped volcano towers over the city of Kayseri?
questions.say: Which snow-capped volcano towers over the city of Kai-seri?
questions.fact: Erciyes, about 3,917 m, is the highest peak of Central Anatolia.
questions.sayAnswer: Mount Air-jee-yes! At about 3917 meters, it is the highest peak of Central Anatolia.

questions.q: What crowns the summit of Mount Nemrut in Adıyaman?
questions.say: What crowns the summit of Mount Nemroot in Adi-yaman?
questions.fact: King Antiochus I of Commagene built it in the 1st century BC.
questions.sayAnswer: Giant stone heads! King Antiochus the First of Commagene built it in the first century B C.

questions.q: A second Mount Nemrut, a volcano with a crater lake, is in which province?
questions.say: A second Mount Nemroot, a volcano with a crater lake, is in which province?
questions.fact: This Nemrut's caldera, beside Lake Van, is the largest in Türkiye.
questions.sayAnswer: Bitlis! This Nemroot's caldera, beside Lake Van, is the largest in Turkey.
